sources.retrieval: Official documentation excerpt retrieved through web search; relevant rref, rref_den and solve_den sections observed.
sources.notes: SymPy distinguishes ordinary division-based elimination, fraction-free elimination using exact divisions, and denominator clearing before fraction-free elimination. Its guidance associates different choices with matrix sparsity and denominator complexity. This motivates two competing candidates rather than a universal speed claim. Merlin will retain its Fraction interface and evaluate exact output, pivoting, singular handling and input preservation independently.
sources.implementation_scope: No new SymPy dependency. Candidate algorithms use Python standard-library exact arithmetic.

sources.title: fractions — Rational numbers
sources.retrieval: Official Python3.9.25 page opened successfully; constructor, normalization and ratio sections observed.
sources.notes: Constructing Fraction from numerator and denominator preserves a rational value. Python3.9 normalizes these components using gcd. Float input represents the binary floating-point value, so converting through floats would change the exact task. Candidate and reference inputs therefore remain integer pairs and Fraction objects.
